payout_quote: Refer a friend to become a member and open ANY CHECKING ACCOUNT today, and you can BOTH receive $150. The $150 incentive will be deposited to the Regular Savings account in both memberships when the qualifying transactions are met. No cap on how many incentives can be earned by referring members.
steps: Ensure you have an active Transcend Regular Savings account in good standing.
Refer a friend to become a Transcend member and open their first checking account (GoGreen, Rate Rewards, Benefits, Classic, Prestige, or Anew checking).
The friend completes within the first 90 days: 20 posted debit card transactions or $500 in cumulative direct deposits, and keeps the account open 180 days.
When the qualifying transactions are met, $150 is deposited to your Regular Savings account and $150 to your friend's.
catches: Referred friend must be a new member opening their first Transcend checking account (valid on GoGreen, Rate Rewards, Benefits, Classic, Prestige, Anew checking).
New account must have 20 posted debit card transactions or $500 in cumulative direct deposits within the first 90 days and remain open 180 days.
Referring member must have an active Regular Savings account in good standing.
$150 bonus is deposited to the Regular Savings account of both memberships, not checking.
Bonus may be taxable as interest income and reported on IRS Form 1099-INT.
Offer and terms subject to change without notice.
biggest_catch: Friend must be a new Transcend member opening their first checking account; the new account must complete 20 posted debit card transactions or receive $500 in cumulative direct deposits within 90 days and stay open 180 days; the referring member needs an active Regular Savings account in good standing.
eligibility: Referrer must be a Transcend member with an active Regular Savings account in good standing; referred friend must be a new member (first checking account only) meeting Kentucky membership eligibility.
timing: Referral share takes ~5 minutes active; bonuses deposit to both Regular Savings accounts when qualifying transactions are met.
